evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story in the backlog expresses the same requirement for creating a new game with name/description.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: Invitation via URL is not duplicated elsewhere; other invite-related stories specify different constraints (e.g., limit).

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires starting a round using a single multi-line text field.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Similar theme appears for estimators, but this is for moderator specifically; actor/context differ.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: This story includes re-estimation functionality that is substantially the same requirement as PP-013 (estimating a previously estimated story again).

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates the addition of new items to the list in this way.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Editing items is not duplicated elsewhere with the same actor/context/goal.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Deleting items is a distinct requirement not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: This specifies immediate reveal even if not all estimates are in; distinct from stories that reveal after all have played.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting the average is a specific moderator action not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: have the "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Auto-filling when all cards match is a specific behavior not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual entry of the agreed estimate is distinct from automated or averaging behaviors.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: This duplicates PP-005's explicit inclusion of re-estimation (select an item to be estimated or re-estimated); same actor and goal.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Importing from a file is a distinct mechanism (not duplicated by copy/paste story).

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste is a different input mechanism than import; not substantially the same requirement.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing a list of previous games is distinct from viewing or exporting a game's transcript.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing a transcript is a specific action distinct from browsing or exporting; not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Export as HTML is a specific format/requirement distinct from exporting as CSV or viewing transcripts.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Export as CSV is a different format from HTML; not a duplicate requirement.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Deleting a game is a unique requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.rationale: Login requirement is distinct and not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Account detail changes are unique compared to other account-related stories.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion is distinct from deleting games or other features.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display requirement is unique and not duplicated.

evaluations.rationale: Password reminder via email is a distinct requirement.

evaluations.rationale: Selecting estimation card sets is a specific configuration requirement not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round

evaluations.evidence: be able start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Providing a startable shared timer is a unique interactive feature not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Automatic reset behavior is a specific timer requirement distinct from starting the timer.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
